# MindForge

> Agentic-intelligence framework for Claude Code and Antigravity: slash commands, subagents, skills, hooks, governance, memory, and cost-aware model routing for AI-driven development. Ships as the npm package `mindforge-cc` (pure JS runtime, zero native dependencies) plus a Claude Code plugin marketplace entry.

MindForge installs into a project via `npx mindforge-cc@latest` and adds an interface layer (slash commands, subagents), a declarative engine spec (skills, personas, config), a Node runtime (autonomous wave execution, memory, governance, model routing), and a persistence layer (audit trail, state, sql.js-backed knowledge graph). It also ships a standalone MCP server (`mindforge-mcp-server`) and a TypeScript SDK (`mindforge-sdk`).

## Packages

- [mindforge-cc](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mindforge-cc): the framework — install into a project
- [mindforge-mcp-server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mindforge-mcp-server): standalone MCP server exposing the MindForge engine over stdio
- [mindforge-sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mindforge-sdk): TypeScript SDK
